name: OpenEden
description: OpenEden is a real-world asset tokenization platform, building the bridge to a new financial system. OpenEden's mission is to unlock trillions by bringing real-world assets on-chain, seamlessly and securely.

methodology.Fees: Management fee of 0.30% per annum accrued daily on assets under management, plus the transaction fee collected on subscriptions (base rate 5 basis points, net of any partnership adjustment up or down).
methodology.Revenue: Management fees of 0.30% per annum accrued daily on assets under management and the transaction fee collected on subscriptions (base rate 5 basis points, net of any partnership adjustment up or down).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Management fees of 0.30% per annum accrued daily on assets under management and the transaction fee collected on subscriptions (base rate 5 basis points, net of any partnership adjustment up or down).

Fees.Management Fees: Management fee of 0.30% per annum accrued daily on assets under management.
Fees.Transaction Fees: Transaction fee actually collected on subscriptions, the totalFee the vault transfers to oplTreasury. Base rate is 5 basis points, then adjusted by the partnership fee where one applies. That adjustment can raise or lower the fee, is floored at the minimum transaction fee when it is not negative, and leaves nothing collected when it fully offsets the base fee.

Revenue.Transaction Fees: Transaction fee actually collected on subscriptions, the totalFee the vault transfers to oplTreasury. That adjustment can raise or lower the fee, is floored at the minimum transaction fee when it is not negative, and leaves nothing collected when it fully offsets the base fee.

That adjustment can raise or lower the fee, is floored at the minimum transaction fee when it is not negative, and leaves nothing collected when it fully offsets the base fee.

methodology.Fees: All fees from users mint/redeem USDO, yields and management fees from backing assets.
methodology.UserFees: Users pay fees to minting/redeeming USDO.
methodology.Revenue: Mint/redeem USDO fees and 0.3% annual is charged by the Investment Manager.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Mint/redeem USDO fees and 0.3% annual is charged by the Investment Manager.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Backing assets yields collected and distributed to suppliers via USDO token rebasing.

Fees.Assets Yields: USDO backing assets yields from all investments.

UserFees.Mint/Redeem Fees: Users pay fees when mint/redeem USDO.

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: USDO backing assets yields from all investments.
